description: gcc/testsuite/gcc.dg tests whose applicable dg-do is `run` (top level, torture, tree-ssa, ipa, atomic, sso, tls, cpp, special, debug, charset, weak, rtl). Pass = exit 0 (and stdout equal to the gcc -O0 binary's where the test has a dg-output). Per-test flags from dg-options in <test>.c.flags; skip.txt lists inapplicable tests and tests gcc -O0 itself fails. Regenerate with tests/scripts/import_gcc_dg.py.
